data.name: Operation Together VR
data.detailed_description:
Operation Together VR is a 1–4 player military simulation VR game focused on tactical teamwork and coordinated operations.

Players take the role of a special operations unit deployed to various mission areas. Your objective is to move strategically, neutralize hostile threats, and safely rescue civilians while securing the operation zone.

With realistic weapon handling, communication-driven gameplay, and VR-specific interactions, every mission offers a unique tactical experience. Success depends on smart planning, situational awareness, and precise execution.

Play solo if you prefer, or team up with friends to carry out operations together and complete the mission as a unit!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600k or equivalent
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Geforce GTX 1660 ti or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Required
  • VR Support: SteamVR. OpenXR, Quest 3, Quest 2, Quest Pro, Oculus Rift S, Valve Index, and HTC Vive.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 8400 or equivalent
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Geforce GTX 1070 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Required
  • VR Support: SteamVR. OpenXR, Quest 3, Quest 2, Quest Pro, Oculus Rift S, Valve Index, and HTC Vive.

content_descriptors.notes: The game contains military-themed armed combat. Players participate in tactical operations where hostile enemies are neutralized as part of mission objectives. Violence is presented in a mission-based and contextual manner. The game does not contain sexual content, nudity, sexual assault, drug or alcohol use, self-harm, or hate speech. Civilians appear as objectives to be rescued, and violence is not directed toward them.
